item.title: Americans' social activity has steeply declined in the past 30 years
item.description:

item.title: Anthropic's Scion is heavily inspired by Mononoke
item.description:
📝 Here is Anthropic describing (archive link) yesterday how their new version control system, Scion, uses a concept called “derived data” to make operations like blames more efficient:How Anthropic describes Scion’s derived data. The fact that Sapling was only credited for “hard-won lessons”, and that Mononoke was not mentioned at all, borders on plagiarism. The post comes off as Anthropic claiming that Claude designed all this, while the reality is that our (extraordinary) team at Meta came up with many of the insights that Claude dutifully applied almost a decade later.
🔗 Read more: https://sunshowers.io/posts/anthropic-mononoke/
